name: Inspector Android
label: Android app
summary: Gas line and pressure station inspection app for Wigersma & Sikkema that talks to measurement devices over Bluetooth.
description: Gas line and pressure station inspection app for Wigersma & Sikkema, developed at Vivasoft in 2024 and 2025. It exchanges Bluetooth commands and data with measurement devices and shows inspection instructions and pressure and leakage graphs.
contributions: Bluetooth commands and data exchange with measurement devices, inspection instructions, pressure and leakage graphs.
Revamped the UI, reworked core logic for stability and upgraded the app to the latest Android version.
